sections.title: Unit 10: Commercial Negotiation & Corporate Law in Hungary
body: In a globalized economy, Hungarian commercial negotiation and corporate law operate at the intersection of civil law doctrine, EU regulatory harmonization, and Anglo-American contractual drafting conventions.

In this unit, you will examine Hungarian corporate jurisprudence: cross-border M&A transactions, venture capital term sheets, competition law (Gazdasági Versenyhivatal), public procurement integrity, and the harmonization of domestic business law with the EU Single Market.
